distribution.summary: 福建；广东；海南；江西；西藏；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) and Lin et al. (2024) support Fujian, Guangdong, Hainan, Jiangxi, Xizang and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010), under the source name Cyclorhipidion formosanum, adds earlier Taiwan locality evidence. Smith et al. (2022) independently supports Fujian, Jiangxi, Xizang and Taiwan; it adds no new region to the current synthesis.

host_note: Current hosts remain Machilus leptophylla, Mallotus sp., Saurauia tristyla, and Ficus sp. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports host unknown for the Cyclorhipidion formosanum source entry. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host in the integrated record; no host is added.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus formosae (Wood, 1992).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 131.

taxonomic_history.name: Xylosandrus formosae
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xylosandrus formosae (Wood, 1992), VSN_6525. Beaver & Liu (2010) used Cyclorhipidion formosanum as a new combination; this historical source name is retained as nomenclatural provenance. Smith et al. (2020) later treated the taxon in Xylosandrus.
